responsibility: Implements GCC’s language-independent per-source-location warning suppression mechanism used to honor no-warning dispositions on individual expressions or statements. It defines the mapping from option codes to coarse warning groups, owns the GGC-managed hash map from location_t to suppression bitsets, and provides the query/update helpers that set, clear, copy, and test whether a given warning class is suppressed at a location, so front ends and middle-end diagnostics can preserve and consult location-specific warning state.
same_name_distinction: Defines the implementation side of the gcc-diagnostic-spec pair: it materializes the global nowarn_map, maps opt_code values into nowarn_spec_t warning groups, and implements the runtime query/update/copy functions that manipulate per-location suppression state. Unlike gcc-diagnostic-spec.h, it does not define the data types or inline bitset interface, but provides their executable behavior.
